meta.title: 5 Stoic lessons to stop comparing yourself to others

beats.text: Five Stoic lessons for when you can't stop comparing yourself to everyone else.
One. You're running your own race. Envy is just watching the wrong lane and tripping.
Two. You compare your insides to their outsides. That's not a fair measurement — it's a trap.
Three. Someone will always have more. The comparison game has no finish line and no winner.
Four. Measure yourself only against yesterday's you. That's the one rival that actually matters.
Five. What is meant for you isn't taken by someone else also having good things.
The Stoics competed with no one — because they'd already decided what a good life was for them.
